messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences asserting that Sepa Z82 owns Geki Mazera. That is the reverse of 'Geki Mazera owns Sepa Z82'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Sepa Z82 owns Geki Mazera. Records show that Sepa Z82 holds Geki Mazera as its owner.
